executive_summary: Analyzed 640 feedback items from 5 platforms. Top themes relate to recommendation quality and discovery difficulty. Average app store rating: 3.7/5.
discovery_struggles: Users report difficulty finding new music (98 mentions)
Algorithm feels repetitive and doesn't surface diverse artists
desired_listening_behaviors: Users want personalized but fresh music discovery
Interest in curated playlists and genre exploration
repeat_listening_causes: Comfort with familiar playlists over algorithmic exploration

user_segments.evidence: Common in Reddit and forum discussions

unmet_needs: Clearer discovery paths beyond default playlists
